transcript.text: lg w/d keeps saying dE n wont start?? door is shut

I can't confirm what DE means on your model, so I'll go by what it is doing. From what you have described, the most likely cause is the door lock (interlock). Open the door, make sure nothing is caught in the seal, then close it firmly until it clicks and start a programme. Does the door click locked now?
[Helpful to see: image "About the door lock (interlock)" — The door lock (interlock) keeps the door shut during a wash and stops the machine starting unless the door is locked. This reference shows where it sits. If the door won't open, wait 2–3 minutes after the cycle ends for the lock to release before trying again. A faulty interlock is a replacement part best fitted by a qualified engineer.]
ok tried, it closes but kinda springs back a bit. theres a corner of the duvet squashed in the seal tho

With the machine unplugged, look at the small hook (catch) on the door and the slot it goes into, and check the door lines up squarely when you close it. Is the catch broken, bent or the door dropped on its hinge, was something blocking it (now cleared), or does it all look fine?
hook looks fine, nothing bent or broken. its just the duvet bulging against the glass n squashed in the seal
That fits the door lock (interlock). Once that is sorted, run it again: does it work normally now?
idk how to sort it tho?? i havent changed anything yet, what do i do

Open the door, tuck the corner of the duvet fully inside the drum so none of it is caught in the rubber seal, and if it's still bulging against the glass, take it out and reload it more loosely or wash it on its own. Then close the door firmly until it clicks shut and stays closed without springing back. That fits the door lock (interlock). Once that is sorted, run it again: does it work normally now?
ok will try tucking it in n closing it again, brb
